guide_language: Guide language: {name} ({origin}). Change it with --ui-language or ui_language in the configuration.
estimate_measured: from the most recent completed run
estimate_default: rough estimate with a default real-time factor of {rtf}; no completed run found
queue_total: Estimated inference time for the whole queue: {total} ({basis}). Preparation and the first model load are not included.
parameters_header: Run parameters (press Enter to accept the value in brackets)
ask_language: Spoken language (code such as it or en, a name such as Italian, or auto) [{default}]:
language_unsupported: '{text}' is not a language the Qwen3-ASR model supports. Type a code or a name (it, italian, italiano); supported codes: {codes}. Type auto to let the model detect it.
language_invalid: '{text}' does not look like a language code (for example it, en).
transcript_language_note: The transcript is written in the spoken language. Translation is out of scope: run it as a separate step on the finished transcript if you need it.
context_help_qwen: Optional context is sent to the model as system context (names, topic, special terms); it biases recognition and does not instruct the model.
context_help_prompt: Optional context replaces the built-in instruction prompt (response mode {mode}), so write it as a complete instruction.
context_backend_skipped: The {backend} backend does not use context or instructions; that question is skipped.
ask_context:
Context / instructions (one line, or @path\to\file.txt for a UTF-8 file; max {limit} characters; Enter = none).{reuse}
>
context_reuse: Type = to reuse the previous one {preview}.
context_unreadable: Could not read the UTF-8 context file {path}: {error}
context_too_long: The context has {length} characters; the limit is {limit}. Shorten it (names, topic and key terms are enough).
ask_scope: Scope: full file, or only the first N minutes (a number) [{default}]:
minutes_not_number: '{text}' is not a number of minutes; type full for the whole file.
minutes_type: The scope must be a number of minutes or full.
minutes_positive: The number of minutes must be greater than zero.
ask_same_for_all: Apply these answers to all {count} files? [Y/n]:
summary_model: model {model} | backend {backend} | response mode {mode} | parallel requests {parallel}
summary_versions: A different language, context or scope creates a new version in output/<source>/<version>/; earlier versions are kept.
bounded_note: Bounded runs keep the file in the input folder.
cancelled_eof: Input ended; cancelled. Nothing was processed.
no_media: No media files found in {folder}. Copy audio or video files there and start the wizard again.
